prompt:
Create a production foliage sprite atlas for a stylized Korean webtoon 3D tree. TRANSPARENT background, portrait image, EXACT regular grid of FOUR columns and SIX rows = 24 separate sprites, no labels, no grid, generous transparent gutters. Each sprite stays inside its own cell.
Subject: GINKGO fan-shaped leaves, approximately 45–70 SMALL simple fan-shaped leaves per sprite. This is foliage only, no trunk, no pot, no visible twigs. No outlines, no veins, no strokes, no gradients, no photographic texture. Every leaf is a clean, solid filled shape. Use just three closely related green colors across the leaves, without baked dark center shading.
CRUCIAL SHAPES: these are loose, airy, irregular leaf SPRAYS spread along branching trajectories, NOT ROUND BUSHES. The silhouette must have deep inward bays, long tapered fingers, broken lobes, uneven density and MANY BIG TRANSPARENT HOLES throughout the center. Around 45 percent of the region inside the silhouette should remain empty transparent space. Holes are real alpha transparency. Do not fill the center with an opaque green base. Leaf subgroups follow curved diagonal and forked paths, never a radial rosette or round pompom. Leaves overlap locally in groups of 4–8 with air gaps between those groups. No isolated dust or microscopic speckles.
The FOUR columns are visibly different large-scale patterns: 1 a long diagonal asymmetric fork with a deep V gap, 2 a loose bent zigzag/S spray with large interior holes, 3 a broad uneven crescent with a missing center and interrupted edge, 4 a forked wind-swept branching shape with three unequal fingers and a hollow pocket.
Rows 1,2,3 show respectively underside / side / above views of the same FOUR green shapes. Keep green brightness similar across rows; shading will be computed in 3D.
Rows 4,5,6 repeat respectively underside / side / above views of the same FOUR shapes in saturated golden-yellow AUTUMN colors, again flat filled leaf shapes and transparent holes. Each of the24sprites individually complete, not touching neighbors. Shapes spread over about 80 percent of each cell, with at least10percent transparent margin on all sides. Organic leaf masses, sparse and perforated like actual outer tree branches, never a round object.
